title: Derivative Formula for Multiple Eisenstein Series
statement: For every word $w\in\mathbb Q\langle z_2,z_3,\ldots\rangle$, prove the conjectural derivative identity $2\pi i\,\frac{d}{d\tau}G(w)=G(\theta(w))$, where $\theta=-D\circ\varphi$ is defined using the Drop1 operator.
